falsifier: Moves to `mid` only if BOTH: TrendForce's 1Q27 conventional-DRAM contract forecast lands at or above 4Q26's +3-8% QoQ (deceleration stops), AND at least one hyperscaler raises 2027 capex guidance at the Oct/Nov round. Moves to `rolling` on EITHER a hyperscaler capex guidance cut/order pushout OR a negative QoQ conventional-DRAM contract print. Moves to `accelerating` only on re-acceleration of the QoQ contract series -- a record price level at a slower rate does not qualify.
priced_in_read: Bifurcated. The semicap/infra layer is paying MORE per unit of capex growth than 3m ago -- KLAC/LRCX/AMAT/TER re-rated hard on 2026-09-04 into a decelerating pricing series, the classic late signature. Memory itself is paying LESS: MU at ~6x forward with ~$18B customer prepayments and ~$100B contracted minimum revenue is not a multiple capitalizing peak EPS.

TrendForce attributes the 4Q26 convergence to weak end demand and elevated inventory levels
NAND contract decelerating on the same path: 3Q26 +10-15% QoQ, 4Q26 to converge further
SEMI equipment billings 1Q26 $36.55B: +14% YoY but only +1% QoQ -- record level, flat sequential
